description: This file is a shell script containing tests for Git's work tree and repository configuration handling. It includes setup procedures, configuration variations, and verification functions to test Git's behavior regarding repository locations, work trees, GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE environment variables, and related commands.

methods.name: test_rev_parse
methods.description: Helper function to verify the status of the Git repository (bare, inside git dir, inside work tree, prefix), and compare actual output against expected output.
